method: Every R9 finding opened in the KB file and checked against the extracted repo tree (read-only temp copies of the real commits). Classes: true-stale = the referenced repository artifact is absent and the KB line is an actionable defect under the declared KB contract; false-positive-by-contract = the reference points at a declared runtime/generated/external location and is not a defect under the committed config (allow_missing), so the generic config finding is adjudicated out.

findings.evidence: Parent and fix-commit trees contain no docs/ directory at all (git ls-tree of both commits); the line is unchanged by the fix commit, so the finding persists after repair.
Same missing docs/ directory; line unchanged by the fix commit.
Same missing docs/ directory; line unchanged by the fix commit.

Root Makefile at the parent commit has targets install/lint/test-unit/test-integration/profile/profile-light/profile-compare/profile-nsys/profile-ncu/profile-chrome/profile-ncu-list/smoke/server/cli/clean but no profile-deep; the fix commit replaces the line with `make profile-chrome` (target exists) - 1 of the 2 deleted/2 inserted lines in AGENTS.md.

KB line itself says `make profile` writes JSON to artifacts/last_profile.json: a generated runtime artifact, intentionally absent from the checkout. Suppressed by the committed config allow_missing ^(artifacts|...)/; only the generic (no allow_missing) sensitivity scan reports it.
External 150 GB model store (`weights/`, 46 safetensors) referenced by the KB but deliberately not in the repository; suppressed by the same allow_missing recipe.

docs/ contains api.md, compare_engram_lora_analysis.md, distributed.md, paper_alignment.md, tutorial.md - no performance.md; the fix commit rewrites the line to point at docs/paper_alignment.md (exists). 5 changed lines in AGENTS.md total.

non_r9_stale_repair.detail: The same fix commit also renames the stale skill name `memory-update` -> `short-term-memory` (4 occurrences). The repo has .agents/skills/short-term-memory/SKILL.md and no memory-update directory, but the name is not a path-like reference, so R9 does not report it: a rule-surface limit, recorded here manually.
